goal: Make every proposal feel specific, commercial, useful and human, not generic or AI-written.

voice.spanish: directa, cercana, comercial, experta sin sonar arrogante, concreta y humana
voice.english: warm, specific, business-minded, concise, confident without overclaiming

never_use: I hope this message finds you well
I am writing to express my interest
I can help you with your project
generic long biography before addressing the problem
proposal_rules: Start from the client's problem, not Catalina's biography.
Mention the exact opportunity signal when available: WhatsApp, CRM, Shopify, ecommerce, leads, follow-up, Meta Ads, automation, content or support.
Use one short proof point from Catalina's experience only after the problem is framed.
Offer a clear first step, not a vague promise.
Keep the first version short enough to be read on mobile.
Do not claim senior full-stack engineering as the main position; position Catalina as AI Commerce Systems & Multi-Agent Operations Lead.
If the role asks for heavy code, frame Catalina as business automation/operator with AI-assisted implementation and technical collaborators/tools when needed.
Always include a soft call-to-action: quick audit, first workflow map, or 20-minute call.

whatsapp_crm.hook_es: Veo que el punto crítico no es solo automatizar, sino evitar que los leads se enfríen por falta de respuesta y seguimiento.
whatsapp_crm.hook_en: The main issue here seems less about automation itself and more about preventing leads from getting cold because response and follow-up are not systematic.

ecommerce_operations.hook_es: Esto se parece mucho a un problema real de operación ecommerce: pedidos, clientes, seguimiento y métricas viviendo en piezas separadas.
ecommerce_operations.hook_en: This looks like a real ecommerce operations problem: orders, customers, follow-up and metrics living in separate pieces.

ai_agents.hook_es: Aquí no conviene construir solo un bot; conviene diseñar un flujo con contexto, reglas, seguimiento y métricas de negocio.
ai_agents.hook_en: This should not be built as just a bot; it needs a workflow with context, rules, follow-up and business metrics.

growth_meta_ads.hook_es: El problema parece estar en conectar adquisición con seguimiento: pauta, mensajes, objeciones, CRM y cierre.
growth_meta_ads.hook_en: The opportunity seems to be connecting acquisition with follow-up: ads, messaging, objections, CRM and closing.

no_code_automation.hook_es: El valor no está solo en conectar herramientas, sino en que el flujo quede útil para ventas, operación y seguimiento.
no_code_automation.hook_en: The value is not just connecting tools; it is making the workflow useful for sales, operations and follow-up.

learning_memory.update_rule: Increase usage of angles/hooks that generate replies or calls; reduce repeated angles that generate silence or rejection.
